create_regresslm_from_scratch: create a RegressLM model from scratch with configurable encoder/decoder layers and model dimensions
fine_tune_regresslm: fine-tune a RegressLM model on a sequence of training examples with optional validation data
sample_regresslm_predictions: sample predictions from a fine-tuned RegressLM model given a sequence of text inputs
create_regresslm_from_t5gemma: create a RegressLM model using a T5Gemma encoder with optional weight freezing and random initialization
test_regresslm_demo: test the RegressLM demo workflow including model creation, fine-tuning, and sampling
